eps.ov: A Native Alter named Kazuma uses a plane to attack kidnappers and finish a job. Now the police organizations named Hold and Holy are after him, thinking he's a dangerous criminal just because he's a Native Alter. But, Kazuma proves that he's not bad when he takes on a renegade group leader, Biff, and saves the Native Alters. Kazuma just seems to have a grudge against Holy.
eps.oa: يستعمل «كازوما»، أحد «مستعملي ألتر الأصليين»، طائرة ليهاجم خاطفين وينجز مهمة. والآن تلاحقه منظمتا الشرطة «هولد» و«هولي»، ظناً أنه مجرم خطر لا لشيء إلا لأنه من مستعملي ألتر الأصليين. لكن كازوما يثبت أنه ليس شريراً حين يواجه «بيف»، زعيم جماعة متمردة، وينقذ مستعملي ألتر الأصليين. ويبدو أن لكازوما ثأراً مع هولي.

eps.ov: The organization of Holy is explained more clearly as is how Ryuho and Mimori first met. Both Ryuho and Mimori gain a bigger interest in the Native Alter, Kazuma.
eps.oa: تتضح طبيعة منظمة «هولي» أكثر، وكذلك كيف التقى «ريوهو» و«ميموري» أول مرة. ويزداد اهتمام ريوهو وميموري كليهما بـ«كازوما»، أحد مستعملي ألتر الأصليين.

eps.ov: After being captured by Holy, Kazuma is imprisoned and offered two choices; join HOLY or be imprisoned. When a sympathetic Mimori sets Kazuma free, he must find a way to escape the confines of HOLY Headquarters.
eps.oa: بعد أن تأسر «هولي» «كازوما»، يُسجن ويُخير بين أمرين: الانضمام إلى هولي أو البقاء سجيناً. وحين تطلق «ميموري» المتعاطفة سراحه، عليه أن يجد طريقة للفرار من حدود مقر هولي.

eps.ov: After hearing about Kazuma's escape from Holy, a new client, Ayase Terada, hires Kazuma and Kimishima to rescue her sick brother and the villagers from a Hold camp.
eps.oa: بعد أن تسمع بفرار «كازوما» من «هولي»، تستأجر عميلة جديدة، «أياسي تيرادا»، كازوما و«كيميشيما» لإنقاذ أخيها المريض وأهل القرية من معسكر لـ«هولد».

eps.ov: After returning from a mission, Kazuma and Kimishima find Kanami lying on the floor sick. Without the proper medical knowledge, Kazuma and Kimishima are forced to find a doctor of Holy.
eps.oa: بعد العودة من مهمة يجد «كازوما» و«كيميشيما» «كانامي» ممددة على الأرض مريضة. ولأنهما لا يملكان المعرفة الطبية اللازمة، يُضطران إلى البحث عن طبيب من «هولي».

eps.ov: With much resentment toward Hold and Holy, some Native Alters, including Kazuma and Kimishima, plan an attack on a Holy cargo van. Knowing this, Holy plats a trap.
eps.oa: يخطط بعض «مستعملي ألتر الأصليين»، ومنهم «كازوما» و«كيميشيما»، مدفوعين بنقمة شديدة على «هولد» و«هولي»، لمهاجمة شاحنة بضائع تابعة لهولي. وتعلم هولي بذلك فتنصب فخاً.

eps.ov: Trapped underground, Kazuma and Tachibana call a temporary truce in order to find a way out. When they do a find a way out, a giant monster appears. Kazuma instantly resorts to attacking it, which Tachibana disapproves of.
eps.oa: يعلق «كازوما» و«تاتشيبانا» تحت الأرض، فيعقدان هدنة مؤقتة ليجدا مخرجاً. وحين يجدانه يظهر وحش عملاق، فيبادر كازوما إلى مهاجمته في الحال، وهو ما لا يرضاه تاتشيبانا.

eps.ov: After being told that he must re-enter Holy to rescue the others, Kazuma charges right though the front door. Unfortunately, a Holy member, Unkei uses his alter, the Mad Sprict, to control Kazuma and the events that surround him.
eps.oa: بعد أن يُقال لـ«كازوما» إن عليه أن يدخل «هولي» من جديد لينقذ الآخرين، يندفع مقتحماً الباب الأمامي. لكن «أونكي»، أحد أفراد هولي، يستعمل «ألتر» الخاص به، «ماد سكريبت»، ليتحكم في كازوما وفي الأحداث من حوله.

eps.ov: Wanting to stop Holy once and for all, Kazuma ventures into the Alter forest in hopes of gaining more power.
eps.oa: يريد «كازوما» أن يوقف «هولي» مرة واحدة وإلى الأبد، فيغامر بدخول غابة «ألتر» أملاً في نيل مزيد من القوة.

eps.ov: Kazuma and Kimishima come to a town of inners that love Holy due to a man named Emergy Maxfell. Not falling for his trap, Kazuma and Kimishima beat Emergy up and force him to show his true colors. Unfortunately, Emergy's alter only appears when he's in a pinch, and due to Kazuma beating him up, that's exactly what he's in.

After revealing that she knows the truth about the alters and Holy to Commander Sigmar, Mimori is thrown in a cell. There, she recollects the events of the past 10 episodes of the series. She also explains the events of the terrible earthquake, and the birth of the Lost Ground so many years ago.

Hold is still deciding what to do with the town it captured from the previous episode's ending. Kimishima goes home and finds Kanami, who wasn't taken after all! He tells her to make a run for it, but before they even get out of the house, Hold intercepts them and drags them off to the camp with the rest of the towns people. In the camp Kazuma is accused of beeing responsible for the destruction. Kimishima defends his friend in front of the townspeople and flees the scene, together with Kanami.

Wanting revenge for the death of his friend, Kazuma attacks a Hold camp. Hearing the news, Ryuho sets out to find him. The two eventually meet and fight it out. Mimori and Tachibana manage to catch up to them, as do Urizane and Sherrice.

Eight months after the fight and disappearance of Kazima and Ryuho, Mimori, Tachibana, and Cougar search the Lost Ground, seeking answers and the whereabouts of their friends. Elsewhere, Kanami is captured and forced to work at a labor camp.

Not remembering anything, Kazuma is forced to fight in an Alter fighting arena. Mimori and Tachibana show up and try to get Kazuma to remember, but to no avail. Will Kazuma ever remember? And if he does what part of his past will allow him to? Elsewhere, Kanami and Ryuho get closer.
So Kigetsuki and Unkei, along with the Tokonatsu Three Sisters, devise a plain against Ryuho. They want to see how powerful he's gotten since he saw the "other side".

Ayase and Kazuma are forced to fight one another. Ayase explains that after being captured by Holy they experimented on her and made her alter more powerful. Now, if she wants her dying brother to get better, she has to kill Kazuma.

Wanting to find Kazuma, Kanami sets off. Ryuho goes with her to protect her, while Sherrice stays behind and looks over the village. Meanwhile, Cougar informs Mimori and Tachibana that he knows where Ryuho is. The two set off to find him, but instead come across Biff.

Sherrice gets attacked by the darths led by Kigetsuki and his alter, Tokonatsu Three Sisters. Just when it looks grim for Sherrice, Ryuho and the others show up. But, can Ryuho fight back knowing that the villagers' lives are in danger? And will Kigetsuki get Ryuho to open up an alter gate? Meanwhile, Cougar and Kazuma are heading to the scene.
After being reunited after so long, Kazuma and Kanami reminisce about the past. Elsewhere, Ryuho, Tachibana, Sherrice, Mimori, and Cougar all discuss their next plan of action.

After Kyouji Mujo takes Kanami hostage, both Kazuma and Ryuho decide to head out alone and rescue her. Cougar stops them, telling them that they must work together and go with everyone else as a group. Meanwhile, Mujo is still bent on getting Kazuma and Ryuho to open up the other dimension.
Kazuma and Ryuho break into Kyouji Mujo's fortress. They split up for the time being and each meet up with a former ally.

Mimori and Cougar come across Kyouji Mujo. Cougar tells Mimori to go on ahead and find the main power generator so that she can weaken Mujo. But, can Cougar win against the newly powerful Mujo? Elsewhere, Kazuma is having some problems of his own when his right hand looses all feeling. Can he continue fighting? Meanwhile, Ryuho finally comes across the Crystallized Form.
Kazuma and Ryuho finally come across Kyouji Mujo. Kazuma takes him on while Ryuho fights the Crystallized Form.

After Mujo's defeat, the Mainland steps in to clean everything up. But, this is bad news for Kazuma and Ryuho, as the Mainland isn't done with them yet. Kazuma and Ryuho says their goodbyes to their loved ones and set out to fight the Mainland.
With the Lost Ground and Inners rebuilding, Kazuma and Ryuho can finally fight, free of distractions.
